# Third-party assets

## Modular Low-Poly Pipes

- Author: Yanbu
- Source: https://opengameart.org/content/modular-low-poly-pipes
- Files used: `Pipe2-1.obj`, `Pipe2-2.obj`, their MTL files and textures
- License: CC0 1.0 / public domain

The original OBJ material texture paths were changed from the author's absolute workstation path to local relative paths so Unity can import them.

## Uber Stylized Water

- Author: MatrixRex
- Source: https://github.com/MatrixRex/Uber-Stylized-Water
- Files used: compiled Unity 6 URP shader, required HLSL includes, texture set, and the Murky preset material
- License: MIT

Only the runtime files needed by the selected preset are redistributed. The Shader Graph development source, demos, reflection scripts, and sample scenes are intentionally excluded.

The bundled `URP_ShaderGraphCustomLighting` HLSL include is originally by Cyanilux and is also distributed under the MIT License. Its license is retained beside that file.

## URP Underwater Effects — Bubbles

- Author: End3r6
- Source: https://github.com/End3r6/URPUnderwaterEffects
- Files used: `BubblesZone.prefab`, `BubblesShader.shadergraph`, bubble material and texture
- License: MIT

The render-feature scripts and demo scene are not imported; the self-contained particle prefab is used directly.

## Underwater Theme II

- Author: Cleyton Kauffman
- Source: https://opengameart.org/content/underwater-theme-ii
- File used: `Underwater Theme II.ogg`, renamed `Underwater_Theme_II_CC0.ogg`
- License: CC0 / public domain

The OGG distribution is used because the author explicitly identifies it as a seamless loop and recommends OGG/WAV/FLAC rather than MP3 for gap-free looping.
